sentence: This project provides tissue processing equipment, staining and confocal imaging so that vision researchers can prepare and examine eye tissue samples.
This project studies which genetic variants near coronary artery disease risk locations change how genes work, using computational models and screens.
This project tracks and describes drug resistance in malaria parasites at field sites in Uganda, using molecular, parasitological and epidemiological approaches.
This project uses multi-omics technologies to find genetic factors and metabolites linked to atherosclerosis in people of many ethnic backgrounds.
This project studies how substance use and HIV affect each other in a cohort of people who use drugs, such as stimulants and opioids.
This project studies how pentameric ligand-gated ion channels work and are controlled at a molecular level, which may help drug development.
This project studies how oncogenic mutations make acute myeloid leukemia resistant to differentiation therapy, using mouse models and patient samples.
This project tries to find the signals and molecular regulators that control homing receptors on human T cells in autoimmune diseases.
